method: Independent saved JSON/exact-source audit only; no engine, network, build or rerun. Whole-protocol retained inventory balance, not per-step energy closure.

reason.en: the supplied inventory has uncompensated ionic charge. This adapter interprets non-H/O element totals as an analytical component problem and adjusts pH to impose electroneutrality; H/O basis entries are conservation coordinates, not prescribed free-ion concentrations. A reported pH or speciation therefore describes that proton-compensated analytical problem, not a prediction for a complete physical mixture of these ions. Supply the actual counterions or use complete acid, base or salt reagents; no sodium, chloride or other counterion is inferred

binding_qualification: Saved engine source/binary/lock identities agree with frozen designs. Git source blobs and saved manifests are authenticated here. Workspace Cargo.lock is not tracked at this source; this review does not independently rehash the producer lock bytes or binary artifact and does not re-attest deployment.
recommendation: Propose 118-complete-stocks and 84-prepared-basis as two distinct source-bound prepared protocol entries; retain 118-prepared-basis only as an analytical exercise. Original missing identities/refusals remain open.
limits: No empirical rate, electrode kinetics, overpotential, initiation threshold, quantitative empirical yield or full thermal calibration.
Oxalate curated rows lack acid/temperature gating and shipped oxalate equilibrium speciation; warm acidic preparation narrows the demonstrated protocol, not the implementation domain.
84 sequential prepared analytical ions emit intermediate charge and withheld-Tenorite notices; this is not a CuCl2 stock or dissolution-enthalpy repair.
Whole-protocol contents ownership includes all phases. solution species distributions, measured proton fields and lots are not additional matter.
